daily.today_energy: Your intuition is hitting different today, Cancer. Trust that gut feeling pulling you toward something new. The universe is whispering—time to actually listen instead of overthinking every detail.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let someone see the real you without the protective walls. Real connection happens when you stop performing.
daily.career: Your creative energy is peaked right now. That idea you've been sitting on? It's worth exploring. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed—stop waiting for permission to share it.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding energy today. Move it, stretch it, get outside if you can. Even 15 minutes of something gentle shifts your whole vibe and settles your nervous system.

weekly.overview: This week, your intuition is basically glowing. The cosmos is inviting you to trust those gut feelings that have been whispering to you. Lean into conversations that feel authentic, and don't be afraid to show up differently than before.
weekly.love: Connection energy is real right now. Whether you're partnered or solo, there's an invitation to be vulnerable in ways that feel safe. Someone might be trying to get closer—pay attention to the signs. Your heart knows what it needs.
